name: Tablet Mode
author: Andrei Yurik
description: Makes tablet mode work on a 2-in-1: the screen follows the accelerometer, the touchscreen and pen follow the screen, and the built-in keyboard goes quiet while folded. The bar button locks the rotation and opens an on-screen keyboard plugin, which goes away when you open the machine.

barWidget.description: Tap to lock the rotation, turn the screen by hand, or show and hide the on-screen keyboard. Middle-click turns the screen.

schema.label: Which way the screen turns
schema.description: How the accelerometer is mounted. Standard is right for almost every machine. If the screen turns the wrong way, pick the pair that comes out mirrored: portrait-swapped for the two upright positions, landscape-swapped for the two flat ones, rotated-180 when everything is upside down.
